WASHINGTON & CHARLESTON, W. Va.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- United Bankshares, Inc. (“United”) (NASDAQ: UBSI) today announced that its Board of Directors declared a fourth quarter dividend of $0.38 per share for shareholders of record as of December 11, 2026. Dividends per share of $1.52 for the year 2026 represents an increase over the $1.49 per share paid for the year of 2025.

The dividend payout of approximately $51.1 million on 134.5 million shares is payable January 4, 2027. The year 2026 marks the 53rd consecutive year of dividend increases to United shareholders. United is one of only two major banking companies in the USA to have increased its dividend to shareholders for at least 53 consecutive years.

United Bankshares, Inc. is a financial services company with consolidated assets of approximately $34 billion as of September 30, 2026. It is the parent company of United Bank, which comprises over 240 offices located across Washington, D.C., Virginia, West Virginia, Maryland, North Carolina, South Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, and Georgia. Pfizer’s $330 million upfront commitment to three pre-IND in vivo CAR-T programs highlights pharmaceutical industry interest in next-generation engineered T-cell platforms

SRX’s pending acquisition of CERo Therapeutics provides exposure to CER-1236, a clinical-stage engineered T-cell therapy with seven patients dosed in the ongoing Phase 1/1b CERTAIN-T trial

NORTH PALM BEACH, Fla., Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SRX Global Inc. (NYSE American: SRXH) (the “Company” or “SRX”), an AI-enabled platform dedicated to generating long-term shareholder value through investments in high-conviction operating companies and strategic assets, today commented on recent industry activity in engineered T-cell therapies following the November 18, 2026 announcement by Pfizer Inc. (“Pfizer”) of an exclusive licensing agreement with Starna Therapeutics (“Starna”), and provided an update on its pending acquisition of CERo Therapeutics, the operating subsidiary of CERo Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. (OTCQB: CERO) (“CERo Holdings” and, together with CERo Therapeutics, “CERo”), an innovative cellular immunotherapy company advancing engineered T cell therapeutics designed to engage phagocytic mechanisms.

According to Pfizer’s announcement, the agreement covers three pre-IND in vivo chimeric antigen receptor T-cell (“CAR-T”) programs focused on treating autoimmune diseases. Starna will receive an upfront payment of $330 million and is eligible to receive up to $2.3 billion in development and commercial milestone payments, as well as royalties on net sales of approved products. Pfizer also obtained rights to Starna’s technology in inflammation and immunology and in oncology. SRX and CERo are not parties to, and have no involvement in, the Pfizer–Starna agreement.

CERo’s approach differs in technology, therapeutic focus and stage of development. Its lead investigational product candidate, CER-1236, is being evaluated in patients with hematologic malignancies in the ongoing Phase 1/1b CERTAIN-T trial. CER-1236 is based on CERo’s proprietary Chimeric Engulfment Receptor T cell (“CER-T”) platform, which is designed to integrate characteristics of innate and adaptive immunity into a single therapeutic construct intended to engage multiple immune mechanisms against cancer.

“Pfizer’s agreement with Starna is a clear signal that large pharmaceutical companies continue to commit significant capital to differentiated engineered T-cell platforms, even before those programs reach the clinic,” said Kent Cunningham, Chief Executive Officer of SRX Global. “CERo’s technology and indications are different, and we do not view this transaction as a valuation benchmark for CERo. What it does reinforce is our conviction in the long-term strategic importance of this field. CER-1236 is already being evaluated in patients, and our focus remains on supporting the CERo team as it advances the CERTAIN-T trial and on working toward closing the proposed acquisition.”

On November 3, 2026, CERo announced that it had dosed the seventh patient in CERTAIN-T, the fourth patient in the trial’s second cohort. CERo reported no dose-limiting toxicities (“DLTs”) in the three previously treated second-cohort patients during the DLT assessment period, and has reported expansion of infused CER-1236 cells following administration. In its June 2026 update, CERo reported that the observed safety profile remained consistent with earlier findings of no cytokine release syndrome, immune effector cell-associated neurotoxicity syndrome, DLTs or treatment-related severe adverse events during the DLT assessment window. CERo has also expanded its clinical trial sites, including the activation of the University of California, Davis, which also serves as the primary manufacturing site for CER-1236. These clinical results are preliminary, are based on a limited number of patients, and are not sufficient to establish the safety or efficacy of CER-1236.

On October 7, 2026, SRX announced that it had entered into a definitive purchase agreement under which CERo Therapeutics will become a wholly owned subsidiary of SRX Global.

About the CERTAIN-T Trial
The first-in-human, multicenter, open-label Phase 1/1b CERTAIN-T study is designed to evaluate the safety, tolerability, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, and preliminary clinical activity of CER-1236 in patients with hematologic malignancies. The study initially enrolled patients with acute myeloid leukemia (“AML”), including relapsed/refractory AML, measurable residual disease AML, and newly diagnosed TP53-mutated AML, and the protocol has since been amended to include transfusion-dependent myelodysplastic syndromes (“TD-MDS”), high-risk myelodysplastic syndromes (“HR-MDS”), and post-JAK inhibitor myelofibrosis (“MF”). Primary endpoints include safety and tolerability. Secondary endpoints include pharmacokinetics and measures of clinical response, including overall response rate (“ORR”), complete response (“CR”), composite complete response (“cCR”), and measurable residual disease (“MRD”).

SRX Global is an AI-driven platform focused on generating long-term shareholder value through investments in high-conviction operating companies, strategic assets, and technology-enabled opportunities. The Company leverages proprietary technology, data analytics, and disciplined capital allocation to identify and manage investments across multiple sectors.

About CERo Therapeutics Holdings, Inc.
CERo Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. is an innovative immunotherapy company advancing the development of engineered T cell therapeutics for the treatment of cancer. The Company’s proprietary approach to T cell engineering is designed to integrate characteristics of innate and adaptive immunity into a single therapeutic construct intended to engage multiple immune mechanisms against cancer. CERo refers to these engineered cells as Chimeric Engulfment Receptor T cells (“CER-T”).

The Company’s lead investigational product candidate, CER-1236, is being evaluated in hematologic malignancies.

X-CUE Smart Glasses Ready for Clinical Trials Following Over a Decade of Development


WILMINGTON, Del., Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Exicure, Inc. (Nasdaq: XCUR) (“Exicure” or the “Company”) today announced that on November 19, 2026, it entered into a Strategic Business Expansion and Investment Agreement with NeuroQ Biologics Inc. (“NeuroQ”) and Laonz Co., Ltd. (“Laonz”) to expand its business into medical device technologies designed to assist patients with Parkinson’s disease.

The agreement focuses on X-CUE, an augmented-reality smart-glasses technology developed over more than a decade to assist patients with Parkinson’s disease who experience freezing of gait, a condition that can significantly affect mobility and daily activities.


X-CUE augmented-reality smart-glasses technology (product illustration).

X-CUE uses augmented-reality visual cues designed to help patients manage freezing-of-gait episodes and support mobility. According to the technology developers, X-CUE has completed its product development phase for the latest, third-revised version of its medical device and is ready for planned clinical trials intended to support commercialization, with an anticipated clinical evaluation period of approximately six months.

Strategic Investment and Business Expansion
Under the agreement, Exicure intends to acquire an equity interest ranging from 20% to 100% in NeuroQ, primarily through the issuance of Exicure common shares in exchange for NeuroQ shares held by Laonz.

The final acquisition percentage, share exchange ratio, and other transaction terms will be determined through subsequent written agreements, subject to applicable corporate and regulatory approvals and Nasdaq requirements.

Following completion of the proposed share acquisition, Exicure intends to provide up to US$500,000 in development funding to support X-CUE’s clinical evaluation, regulatory advancement, manufacturing preparation, and commercialization initiatives, subject to applicable approvals, funding availability, and definitive funding arrangements.

Advancing X-CUE Toward Commercialization
Laonz has completed the transfer of the X-CUE business, including related intellectual property, technology, assets, and business rights, to NeuroQ.

NeuroQ will lead the continued development, clinical evaluation, regulatory approval, and commercialization of X-CUE, with strategic support from Exicure.

The parties intend to leverage the technology’s extensive development history and current product readiness to advance X-CUE through the remaining clinical and regulatory processes toward potential commercialization.

“Through this strategic agreement, we are expanding Exicure’s business into innovative medical device technologies designed to address important unmet needs among patients with Parkinson’s disease,” said Jung Soo Kim, Chief Executive Officer of Exicure. “With more than a decade of development behind X-CUE and the product ready for planned clinical evaluation, we believe this initiative presents a promising opportunity to advance a differentiated technology toward commercialization and create long-term value for our stockholders.”

About X-CUE
X-CUE is an augmented-reality smart-glasses technology designed to assist patients with Parkinson’s disease who experience freezing of gait.

Developed over more than a decade, X-CUE provides visual cues intended to support mobility during freezing-of-gait episodes.

The product has completed its development phase and is being prepared for clinical evaluation, with an anticipated clinical trial period of approximately six months. Potential commercialization remains subject to successful clinical evaluation and applicable regulatory approvals.

Exicure, Inc. (Nasdaq: XCUR) is a biotechnology company focused on advancing innovative healthcare technologies and pursuing strategic growth opportunities.

The Company’s portfolio includes a clinical-stage program targeting stem cell mobilization for multiple myeloma, sickle cell disease, and cell and gene therapy applications.

WALNUT CREEK, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--

BayCom Corp (NASDAQ: BCML) (the “Company”), the holding company for United Business Bank (the “Bank”), today announced that Stanley R. Ivie was appointed as a director of the Company and as a director of the Bank, effective November 17, 2026.

Mr. Ivie brings decades of leadership, risk management, and regulatory experience in the banking industry and currently serves as Chairman of the California Bankers Association. Most recently, he served Banc of California and its holding company, Banc of California, Inc., as Executive Vice President and Head of Government and Regulatory Affairs from November 2023 until he retired in February 2026. He led Banc of California’s regulatory strategy, served as its liaison to legislative and regulatory agencies and oversaw its Community Reinvestment Act, corporate sustainability and strategic planning programs. Mr. Ivie served as Executive Vice President and Chief Risk Officer of Pacific Western Bank and PacWest Bancorp from March 2016 until PacWest’s merger with Banc of California in November 2023. In his role there, he oversaw Pacific Western Bank’s enterprise risk management strategy and the policies and practices that assess and mitigate financial, operational and strategic risks, including those related to cybersecurity, fraud, modeling and the Bank Secrecy Act.

Previously, Mr. Ivie held various leadership positions with the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation (FDIC), including Regional Director for the FDIC’s San Francisco and Dallas regions. Before joining the FDIC's Supervision Division in 2005, he served as the Deputy Director for the Division of Resolutions and Receiverships in Dallas, where he oversaw the resolution of failing banks nationwide.

“I'm thrilled to welcome Stan to our Board. He is one of the most accomplished risk and regulatory leaders in the industry, and very few people bring his depth of experience. We expect that Stan will play a big role in helping us build this business the right way in the years ahead,” said Bill Black, Executive Vice Chairman.

“We are delighted to welcome Stan Ivie to our Board. Stan brings a rare combination of perspectives,” said Christopher Baron, Chief Executive Officer. “He spent more than three decades at the FDIC and then managed risk and government and regulatory affairs from inside commercial banks larger than ours. His judgment and experience will be invaluable as we continue to grow.”

“Stan Ivie is an excellent addition to BayCom,” said Lloyd Kendall, Chairman of the Board. “His regulatory experience and knowledge, strategic risk management, and leadership will be invaluable to the Board as we continue to execute our strategy.”

$160 million reduction begins with January bills; more than $50 a year for a home using 1,000 kilowatt-hours a month

BIRMINGHAM, Ala., Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Alabama Power customers will pay lower rates beginning with their January bills. The company today filed with the Alabama Public Service Commission to reduce customer rates by $160 million in 2027.

A residential customer using 1,000 kilowatt-hours each month will save more than $50 a year compared with current rates at the same electricity use. However, bills and savings vary based on how much electricity a home uses. For example, a home using 2,000 kilowatt-hours a month will save about $106 a year, while a home using 750 kilowatt-hours a month will save about $40 a year.

"In January, our customers will see their rates go down because of the growth we're seeing across the state," said Jeff Peoples, Alabama Power's chief executive officer. "Alabama is growing and we're making sure that growth works for all of our customers."

Because the change lowers the rate itself, it applies to every monthly bill. Customers do not need to do anything to receive it.

The reduction is driven primarily by increased revenue expected in 2027 from large-load data centers.

"We negotiated these agreements so that growth pays for growth," said Moses Feagin, Alabama Power's chief financial officer. "Large-load data centers pay the full cost to serve their energy needs, which lowers our cost to serve other customers."

The reduction comes at a time when energy costs are rising across the country. Nationally, household electricity prices rose 4.4% over the 12 months ending in September 2026, according to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics. Electric and gas utilities requested more than $23 billion in rate increases nationwide during the first nine months of 2026, according to an October report from PowerLines.

During the same period, Alabama Power froze rates and is now lowering rates.

The lower rate results from the yearly review of Alabama Power's rates under Rate Stabilization and Equalization (RSE) set by the Alabama Public Service Commission. The rate reduction in RSE will stay at or below the new lower level through 2028.

Rates are one part of a bill. The other main factor is how much electricity a home uses. Monthly bills will continue to vary with the weather and electricity use. Through My Power Usage, Alabama Power customers can track daily electricity use and see an estimate of their upcoming bill.

More information about the rate reduction and estimated customer savings is available at AlabamaPower.com/LowerRates.

About Alabama Power

Alabama Power, a subsidiary of Atlanta-based Southern Company (NYSE: SO), provides reliable electricity to 1.6 million customers across the state. Learn more at AlabamaPower.com⁠.

Early Holiday Planning and Coordination with Major Retail Partners Help Support Fresh Herb Availability, Reduce Waste and Keep Thanksgiving Essentials Affordable for Families

BELVIDERE, NJ, Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Edible Garden AG Incorporated (“Edible Garden” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: EDBL, EDBLW), a leader in controlled environment agriculture (CEA), organic and sustainable produce, and developer of the Zero-Waste Inspired® mission and Farm-to-Formula® platform today highlighted its work with Walmart, Meijer, Target and Hannaford to help keep fresh herbs affordable this Thanksgiving. As rising costs put pressure on household budgets, Edible Garden has focused on what it can influence as a grower and supplier, including planning holiday crops early and coordinating deliveries with retail partners ahead of the Thanksgiving rush.

Edible Garden planned ahead for rosemary, sage and thyme, three staples of Thanksgiving cooking. By working from retailers’ anticipated holiday needs, the Company can better match what it grows and packs to what stores expect to sell. That planning helps limit waste and reduce the need for costly last-minute shipments. As orders change during the holiday rush, Edible Garden stays in close contact with retail teams so they can adjust deliveries and keep shoppers informed by way of better-stocked produce departments.

“Families are watching what they spend this Thanksgiving, but they still want to enjoy the fresh, high-quality ingredients that make their holiday traditions special. A little sage goes a long way in a family stuffing recipe, and we want to make sure those essential ingredients remain affordable and readily available,” said Jim Kras, Chief Executive Officer of Edible Garden. “By planning early, anticipating seasonal demand and working closely with leading retailers, including Walmart, Hannaford, Kroger, Meijer, Target and Wakefern/ShopRite, we can better align production with demand, minimize waste and help manage costs throughout the supply chain. Our advanced growing capabilities and efficient distribution network support these efforts, demonstrating how our Zero-Waste Inspired® approach can deliver meaningful value to our retail partners and the families they serve.”

ABOUT EDIBLE GARDEN®

Edible Garden AG Incorporated is a leader in controlled environment agriculture (CEA), delivering organic, better-for-you, sustainable produce and products through its Zero-Waste Inspired® next-generation farming model. Available in over 6,000 retail locations across the United States, Caribbean, and South America, Edible Garden is at the forefront of the CEA and sustainability technology movement, distinguished by its advanced safety-in-farming protocols, sustainable packaging, patented GreenThumb software, and innovative Self-Watering in-store displays. The Company operates state-of-the-art, vertically integrated greenhouses and processing facilities, including Edible Garden Heartland in Grand Rapids, Michigan; Edible Garden Prairie Hills in Webster City, Iowa; and its headquarters at Edible Garden Belvidere in New Jersey. It also partners with a network of contract growers strategically located near major U.S. markets to ensure freshness and reduce environmental impact. The Company is also expanding its Prairie Hills facility in Webster City, Iowa, into a dedicated ready-to-drink (RTD) clean nutrition manufacturing hub, supporting its Farm-to-Formula® strategy and its transformation into higher-margin, shelf-stable nutrition categories.

Edible Garden’s proprietary GreenThumb 2.0 software—protected by U.S. Patents US 11,158,006 B1, US 11,410,249 B2, and US 11,830,088 B2—optimizes vertical and traditional greenhouse growing conditions while aiming to reduce food miles. Its patented Self-Watering display (U.S. Patent No. D1,010,365) is designed to extend plant shelf life and elevate in-store presentation. In addition to its core CEA operations, Edible Garden owns three patents in advanced aquaculture technologies: a closed-loop shrimp farming system (US 6,615,767 B1), a modular recirculating aquaculture setup with automated water treatment and feeding (US 10,163,199 B2), and a sensor-driven ammonia control method utilizing electrolytic chlorine generation (US 11,297,809 B1).

The Company has been recognized as a FoodTech 500 firm by Forward Fooding, is a multi-year participant in Walmart’s Project Gigaton and a Giga Guru designee and has received NRG’s Excellence in Energy Award for its commitment to measurable environmental performance and energy stewardship. Edible Garden also develops and markets a growing line of nutrition and specialty food products, including Vitamin Way® and Vitamin Whey®—plant and whey protein powders—and Kick. Sports Nutrition, a premium performance line for health-conscious athletes seeking cleaner, better-for-you options. The Company’s offerings further include fresh, sustainable condiments such as Pulp fermented gourmet and chili-based sauces, as well as Pickle Party, a collection of fermented fresh pickles and krauts.

TULSA, Okla.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Chad Zamarin, President and CEO of Williams (NYSE: WMB) released the following statement following the U.S. Senate’s passing of the Bipartisan American Affordability and Jobs Act (BAAJA) of 2026:

“The Senate’s passage of BAAJA is an important win for American families and American energy, and now the House has an opportunity to finish the job. We thank Senators Capito, Lee, Heinrich and Whitehouse for working together to advance meaningful, bipartisan permitting reform.

America has the energy, the resources and the capital to build. What we’ve lacked is a permitting system that lets us get it done. The BAAJA can change that, helping deliver the infrastructure we need to lower costs and meet rapidly growing energy demand.

Nowhere is that problem clearer than in the Northeast. During last winter’s cold snap, energy prices in New England spiked by more than 10 times the normal cost because the region simply does not have enough infrastructure to reliably access abundant and affordable American energy. Projects that could help solve that problem have been delayed or blocked for years.

BAAJA takes an important step toward lowering costs for Americans by bringing greater certainty and accountability to the permitting process. That means getting critical energy infrastructure built, strengthening reliability and helping lower energy bills for American families.

We urge the House to act quickly, pass BAAJA and get America back to building.”

The Company intends to use the net proceeds from this Offering for business expansion, general working capital purposes and other general corporate purposes. The Company believes that, as a result of the Offering, it has regained compliance with the stockholders’ equity requirement of The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC (“Nasdaq”) to address the previously reported deficiency, as discussed further below.

The Offering

The Offering is comprised of 14,285,715 units (each a “Unit”), consisting of one Class A ordinary share of the Company, par value $0.00225 per share (the “Class A Ordinary Shares”), or in lieu thereof, a pre-funded warrant, and one warrant to purchase one Class A Ordinary Share (each, a “Warrant”). The public offering price of the Units is $0.35 per Unit. Each of the Warrants has an exercise price of $1.02 per Class A Ordinary Share and be exercisable beginning immediately upon issuance and will expire on the six-month anniversary of the issuance date.

We are registering 14,285,715 Class A Ordinary Shares underlying the Pre-Funded Warrants and 14,285,715 Class A Ordinary Shares underlying the Warrants. Each of the Pre-Funded Warrants will have an exercise price of $0.00225 per Class A Ordinary Share and will be immediately exercisable (subject to the beneficial ownership limitation) and may be exercised at any time until all of the Pre-Funded Warrants are exercised in full.

A holder of the Warrants may, at any time and in its sole discretion, exercise its Warrants in whole or in part by means of a “zero exercise price” option. As a result of this feature, we do not expect to receive any cash proceeds from the exercise of the Warrants because it is highly unlikely that a Warrant holder will elect to pay an exercise price in cash to receive Class A Ordinary Shares when they could elect the “zero exercise price” option in these circumstances to receive more Class A Ordinary Shares than they would receive if they did pay an exercise price. Under the zero-exercise price option, a holder of a Warrant will receive up to fifteen (15) Class A Ordinary Shares for each Warrant without paying any exercise price to us. It is anticipated that all Warrant holders will utilize the zero-exercise price option as this allows for the exercise of the Warrants for no additional consideration and will result in a greater number of Class A Ordinary Shares that investors will receive upon exercise than what would be issuable upon cash exercise or cashless exercise. As a result, there is no practical or financial incentive for holders of the Warrants to exercise the Warrants via cash exercise or cashless exercise and we do not expect to receive any proceeds from the exercise of the Warrants overall. If all 14,285,715 Warrants are exercised under the zero-exercise price option, we would issue an aggregate of 214,285,725 Class A Ordinary Shares for no additional consideration.

Univest Securities, LLC is acting as sole placement agent for the offering.

The Offering was made only by means of a written preliminary prospectus and final prospectus that will form a part of the registration statement. Electronic copies of the final prospectus relating to this offering may be obtained, when available, by contacting Univest Securities, LLC at info@univest.us, or by calling +1 (212) 343-8888.

Stockholders’ Equity Requirement

As previously reported on a Form 6-K, on May 26, 2026, the Company received a letter from Nasdaq indicating that it was not in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(b)(1), because (i) the stockholders’ equity of the Company of $598,490 as of December 31, 2025, as reported in the Company’s Annual Report on Form 20-F for the year ended December 31, 2025, was below the minimum stockholders’ equity requirement of $2,500,000 (the “Nasdaq Equity Requirement”) and (ii) the Company did not, as of May 26, 2026, meet the alternatives standards of market value of listed securities or net income from continuing operations for compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rules 5550(b)(2) and 5550(b)(3), respectively. The Company submitted a plan to regain compliance and was granted 180 calendar days from May 26, 2026 (or until November 20, 2026), to evidence compliance.

Based on the proceeds of funds from the Offering, the Company believes that, as of the date of this press release, it has stockholders’ equity in excess of the Nasdaq Equity Requirement. However, the final determination of compliance is subject to review and approval by Nasdaq. If at any time during the next periodic report the Company does not evidence compliance, the Company may be subject to delisting.

If, at the time of the Company’s next periodic report, the Company is deemed by Nasdaq not to be in compliance, the Company would have the right to request a hearing before a Nasdaq hearings panel pursuant to the procedures set forth in the applicable Nasdaq Listing Rules. However, there can be no assurance that, if the Company does appeal any delisting determination that such appeal would be successful.

While the Company believes it now is compliance with the Nasdaq Equity Requirement, if Nasdaq determines it is not in compliance, the Company will take all reasonable measures available to regain compliance under the Nasdaq Listing Rules and remain listed on Nasdaq. There can be no assurance that Nasdaq will determine that the Company (i) has regained compliance with the Nasdaq Equity Requirement, (ii) will maintain compliance with the Nasdaq Equity Requirement, or (iii) will maintain compliance with the other Nasdaq continued listing requirements or be successful in appealing any delisting determination.

The Company aims to make swimming an enjoyable and affordable sport for children and adults, for water safety and as a way of keeping fit and healthy. Beneficial owners of Public Shares held in “street name,” however, will not need to take any action in order to receive the Redemption Amount. MIAMI, Nov. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- At Kimpton Surfcomber Hotel, art isn't reserved for one week of the year. From its historic Art Deco roots to its ongoing collaborations with local artists, creativity is woven into the essence of the oceanfront South Beach hotel. This Miami Art Week, Surfcomber is building on that legacy with a special lineup of experiences celebrating the talent and artistic spirit of its local community.

From a striking new lobby installation to interactive art experiences at its newly renovated signature restaurant, The Social Club, and a colorful showcase at the Cabanas at its newly opened Solei Beach Club, the programming brings creativity to every corner of the property. Paired with imaginative culinary and cocktail offerings and a special shopping pop-up, the celebration invites guests and locals to experience art in unexpected ways against the backdrop of Surfcomber's idyllic oceanfront setting.

"Art has always been part of Surfcomber's identity, and our connection to Miami's creative community extends far beyond Art Week," said Mohan Koka, General Manager of Kimpton Surfcomber Hotel. "Over the years, we've had the privilege of working with some incredibly talented local artists, and we love finding new ways to bring their creativity into the guest experience. This year's celebration is all about building on those relationships, giving artists a platform to share their work and inviting visitors to experience a side of Miami's art scene they might not otherwise discover."

This year's programming brings together Miami-born artist Alex Nuñez, collage artist Kimberly Welbaum—whose cutmepasteme works have adorned the walls of The Social Club since its renovation—and Miami-based painter Jonathan Pedigo. Together, their distinct artistic styles will take center stage across the property, inviting guests to explore thought-provoking installations, get creative alongside the artists, witness live painting in action and even take home a limited-edition piece of Surfcomber's Art Week celebration.

A Closer Look at Surfcomber's Miami Art Week Programming

No Vacancy, Miami Beach: Alex Nuñez's You Cannot Step into the Same Ocean Twice
As part of the City of Miami Beach's No Vacancy public art program, Surfcomber will welcome Miami-born artist Alex Nuñez for an immersive installation on display from November 12 through December 19. Titled You Cannot Step into the Same Ocean Twice, the exhibition transforms The Nook, the hotel's cozy lobby corner, into an otherworldly environment featuring printed aluminum palms, paintings and works on paper, anchored by an iridescent portal that shifts with the changing light. The installation invites visitors to experience a familiar coastal landscape through an entirely new lens, offering a moment of discovery just steps from the energy of South Beach.

A Celebration of Collage at The Social Club
From November 29 through December 7, Surfcomber's newly renovated signature restaurant, The Social Club, will become a playground for creativity in collaboration with Miami-based collage artist Kimberly Welbaum, the talent behind cutmepasteme. A fixture of The Social Club's artistic identity since its renovation, Welbaum's vibrant, layered works have become part of the restaurant's everyday atmosphere. For Miami Art Week, the hotel is taking that relationship beyond the walls, inviting guests to engage directly with the artist and her creative process through interactive installations, hands-on experiences and exclusive, limited-edition artwork.

  • Your Mark of Art: From November 29 through December 5, guests dining at The Social Club can add their own artistic flair to an interactive art experience led by Kimberly Welbaum. Through hand-cut fragments, color becomes a language for emotion. Together, individual feelings become one collective work of art. Guests are invited to browse a collection of colorful fragments, select the pieces that speak to them and contribute their own arrangement to the evolving artwork. From November 30 through December 7, the new Cabanas at Solei Beach Club will be transformed into a vibrant showcase of local artistry with Flavor of Miami, a collaboration with Miami-based artist Jonathan Pedigo and The Curation Department, a creative platform connecting artists with spaces and audiences through curated art experiences. On Friday, December 4, Pedigo will put an artistic spin on Surfcomber's signature Social Hour with a special live painting experience from 5 to 7 p.m., open to hotel guests and the public alike. Visitors can settle in with a drink in hand and watch as the artist transforms a blank canvas into an original work of art, bringing a little extra color and creativity to the hotel's beloved evening ritual—all against the backdrop of its idyllic oceanfront setting. The Blue Dynasty Experience: Where Art Meets the Menu
From November 30 through December 7, The Social Club will take Miami Art Week indulgence to new heights with the introduction of the Blue Dynasty Experience, an extravagant, limited-time culinary creation from Executive Chef Gastón Javier. Inspired by Johnnie Walker Blue Label, the experience puts a luxurious spin on the classic burger, featuring American Wagyu, aged Alpine cheese, Blue Label bacon jam and winter black truffle, all nestled in a buttery brioche roll. Served alongside duck-fat pomme pavé finished with truffle sea salt and paired with a 2 oz pour of Johnnie Walker Blue Label, the $125 experience offers a decidedly decadent way to savor Miami Art Week.

SMITHFIELD, Va., Nov. 20, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Smithfield Foods donated 40,000 pounds of protein to the 30th Annual Mayflower Marathon Holiday Food and Fund Drive to support the Virginia Peninsula Foodbank and Foodbank of Southeastern Virginia and the Eastern Shore.

“The holiday season reminds us how important it is to come together as a community,” said Jonathan Toms, senior community development manager for Smithfield Foods. “We’re grateful for the work our local foodbanks do throughout the year, and the Mayflower Marathon gives us another chance to support them and help put nutritious protein on the table for families in our area.”

The donated protein, including bacon, ham and sausage, will provide 160,000 servings for neighbors experiencing hunger in the greater Hampton Roads area.

“Many families across the Peninsula rely on the Foodbank and its partners to access higher-cost items like proteins,” said Bob Latvis, president and CEO of the Virginia Peninsula Foodbank. “Smithfield’s commitment to helping ensure that all of our neighbors are able to prepare nutritious, complete meals during the holiday season benefits our whole community.”

More than 25 local Smithfield employees supported the 57-hour event by collecting and organizing donations at the drop-off location in Hampton, Virginia.

“Increasing access to nutritious food is one of our top priorities at the Foodbank, and protein plays an important role in supporting the health and well-being of our neighbors,” said Christopher Tan, president and CEO of the Foodbank of Southeastern Virginia and the Eastern Shore. “Protein is also one of the most expensive foods for families to purchase and for foodbanks to provide. Smithfield's generosity helps us overcome that challenge and ensures more of our neighbors have access to the quality nutrition they need to thrive.”

Smithfield’s support for the Mayflower Marathon continues its long-standing commitment to addressing food insecurity and supporting the communities where its employees live and work.

Since 2008, Smithfield has donated more than 345 million servings of protein to fight hunger and address food insecurity through the company’s Helping Hungry Homes® program. To learn more about Smithfield’s initiatives to strengthen local communities, visit smithfieldfoods.com/good-is-what-we-do. 

About Smithfield Foods
Smithfield Foods, Inc. (Nasdaq: SFD) is an American food company with a leading position in packaged meats and fresh pork products. With a diverse brand portfolio and strong relationships with U.S. farmers and customers, we responsibly meet demand for quality protein around the world.

About Virginia Peninsula Foodbank  
Since 1986, Virginia Peninsula Foodbank has been a leader in local hunger relief by providing access to healthy foods across the nine cities and counties on the Peninsula. With the support of 120 partner agencies, the Foodbank has provided over 200 million meals to families facing hunger. It operates mobile food pantries throughout the month, provides emergency food assistance, prepares weekend bags of food and after-school meals for children, and advocates for our neighbors experiencing food and nutrition insecurity. The Foodbank also runs an accredited Culinary Training program, helping to address root causes of food insecurity and provide opportunities for students in financial hardship. The Foodbank is a proud partner of Feeding America, the Federation of Virginia Food Banks, and the United Way of the Virginia Peninsula. Our vision is to inspire hope by leading the effort for a hunger-free and properly nourished community. For more information, visit us online at our www.hrfoodbank.org.

About the Foodbank of Southeastern Virginia and the Eastern Shore 
Since 1981, the Foodbank of Southeastern Virginia and the Eastern Shore has provided more than 442 million meals to neighbors in need. As the region's largest hunger-relief organization, the Foodbank procures, stores, and distributes millions of pounds of food and other essential grocery products each year, serving 11 cities and counties through a network of 240+ partner agencies and 150 direct distributions. The Foodbank works to increase access to nutritious food for children, seniors, veterans, and families experiencing food insecurity, with fresh produce and lean protein accounting for nearly half of all food distributed. Through the support of dedicated staff, volunteers, donors, and community partners, the Foodbank is helping ensure more neighbors have consistent access to the food they need to live healthy, stable lives. The Immersive Holiday Partnership Features Bespoke Frozen Yogurt by Award-winning Chef & Author Andy Baraghani, Personalized Product Experiences & Festive Programming at Bloomingdale’s 59th Street Flagship

ANDY BARAGHANI IMAGES
UGG PARLOR IMAGES
Photography credit: Julia Khoroshilov

SANTA BARBARA, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--This holiday season, Southern California-based global lifestyle brand UGG® (a division of Deckers Brands [NYSE: DECK]) is partnering with Bloomingdale’s, Forty Carrots and New York Times bestselling and James Beard Award-winning chef and author, media personality and cultural tastemaker Andy Baraghani to introduce the UGG® Parlor, an unexpected fusion of fashion, food and culture at Forty Carrots. Running November 20 through January 3, the partnership brings a playful new perspective to seasonal traditions, combining Bloomingdale’s retail heritage, Forty Carrots’ cult-favorite frozen yogurt, Baraghani’s distinctive culinary perspective and the UGG® brand’s approach to self-expression.

Andy Baraghani x UGG® Parlor

“At UGG, we believe the most memorable gifts are the ones that create a feeling and bring people together in unexpected ways,” said Tracy Paoletti, Vice President & General Manager, UGG North America. “The UGG Parlor at Forty Carrots brings that philosophy to life by blending fashion, food and self-expression into a festive experience that invites consumers to make the season their own. We’re excited to partner with Bloomingdale’s, Forty Carrots and Andy Baraghani to create a new holiday tradition that celebrates the joy of giving, receiving and sharing something special.”

“I’m very much in favor of a frozen yogurt break in the middle of holiday shopping,” said Andy Baraghani. “Working with UGG and Forty Carrots was a chance to take the nostalgic flavors I love this time of year and give them a little twist. I wanted something seasonal that you’d crave well beyond the holidays. Come to the UGG Parlor, have a frozen yogurt, and stay for a second helping.”

UGG® PARLOR AT FORTY CARROTS AT BLOOMINGDALE’S

At the heart of the creative exchange is a custom frozen yogurt experience featuring two bespoke flavors created in partnership with UGG® and Andy Baraghani. UGGingerbread Spice, the signature UGG® flavor, will be available at all Forty Carrots locations across the U.S. and is the perfect balance of Bloomingdale’s signature frozen yogurt with the warm, nostalgic flavors of gingerbread, featuring notes of ginger, cinnamon, and holiday spice. UGGingerbread Nightcap by Andy Baraghani, an exclusive, bespoke creation imagined by the chef himself, will be available only at Forty Carrots at Bloomingdale’s 59th Street flagship in New York City. Featuring creamy frozen yogurt, gingerbread spice, and a hint of dark rum, it's a holiday nightcap you eat with a spoon. Both flavors will be available through January 3.

The partnership transforms an everyday treat into a festive destination, inviting shoppers to experience the partnership through seasonal flavors, personalized product and thoughtful details throughout the holiday season.

The UGG® Parlor will also come to life through a series of consumer activations, including UGG® customization experiences, frozen yogurt sampling and festive touches designed to encourage discovery and invite guests to make the experience their own.

HOLIDAY EXPERIENCES AT THE UGG® PARLOR

Across five weekends in November and December, UGG® and Forty Carrots will bring the UGG® Parlor to life through a rotating lineup of customization experiences, frozen yogurt sampling and festive treats at Bloomingdale’s 59th Street flagship.

Weekend 1: Holiday Takeover Kickoff — Froyo & Customization

Friday, November 20, 3-8 PM
Saturday, November 21-Sunday, November 22, 12-6 PM

Guests can personalize select Classic boots at the UGG® Customization Studio with laser-engraved designs from a curated holiday flash sheet featuring New York City-inspired and seasonal motifs. A custom-branded frozen yogurt sampling cart will also offer guests a taste of the partnership on the fifth floor of Bloomingdale’s 59th Street location.

Weekend 2: Personalize Your Pair

Saturday, November 28-Sunday, November 29, 12-6 PM

The UGG® Customization Studio will continue offering laser engraving on select Classic boots, inviting guests to personalize their pair with NYC-inspired and holiday designs.

Weekend 3: A Sweet Treat & Personalization

Saturday, December 5, 12-6 PM

On Saturday, December 5, customers who purchase men’s or women’s UGG® footwear in-store will be eligible to receive one complimentary small UGGingerbread Spice frozen yogurt at Forty Carrots. To redeem, customers must present their December 5 in-store purchase receipt at Forty Carrots. Offer is valid for purchases made on December 5 only and applies exclusively to the small UGGingerbread Spice frozen yogurt.

The UGG® Customization Studio will also be available for guests to personalize select Classic boots.

Weekend 4: Festive Personalization

Saturday, December 12-Sunday, December 13, 12-6 PM

Guests can continue to personalize select Classic boots with laser-engraved designs inspired by New York City and the holiday season.

Weekend 5: Holiday Sweets & Personalized Treats

Saturday, December 19-Sunday, December 20, 12-6 PM

The holiday programming will conclude with festive touches throughout Bloomingdale’s, including custom UGG® boot-shaped gingerbread cookies distributed on the Women’s sales floor, custom UGG® holiday cards with purchase and live portrait illustrations of guests wearing UGG® products.

Through January 3, The UGG® Parlor at Forty Carrots celebrates the spirit of holiday gifting through an unexpected blend of fashion, food and self-expression. By bringing together the UGG® brand’s distinctive approach to style, Forty Carrots’ iconic frozen yogurt and Andy Baraghani’s creative culinary perspective, the partnership invites shoppers to discover new seasonal traditions and Gift the Feeling through memorable moments of connection, indulgence and joy.

About UGG®

Founded in 1978 by an Australian surfer on the coast of California, UGG® is a global lifestyle brand renowned for its iconic Classic boot. First worn by Hollywood royalty, fashion editors, and then the world, UGG® designs and retails footwear, apparel, and accessories with an uncompromising attitude toward quality and craftsmanship. Delivering more than $2 billion in annual sales, UGG® partners with the best retailers globally and owns concept and outlet stores worldwide in key markets, including New York, San Francisco, Los Angeles, Paris, London, Tokyo, Shanghai, and Beijing. For more information, please visit ugg.com @ugg.

About Deckers Brands

Deckers Brands is a global leader in designing, marketing and distributing innovative footwear, apparel and accessories developed for both everyday casual lifestyle use and high-performance activities. The Company's portfolio of brands includes UGG®, HOKA®, and Teva®. Deckers Brands products are sold in more than 50 countries and territories through select department and specialty stores, Company-owned and operated retail stores, and select online stores, including Company-owned websites. Deckers Brands has over 50 years of history building niche footwear brands into lifestyle market leaders, attracting millions of loyal consumers globally. For more information, please visit www.deckers.com.

About Bloomingdale’s

Bloomingdale’s is America’s only nationwide, full-line, upscale department store. A division of Macy’s, Inc. (NYSE: M), it currently operates 31 Bloomingdale’s stores, 25 Bloomingdale’s The Outlet stores, and 4 Bloomie’s stores in California, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Texas, Virginia, and Washington. In addition, Bloomingdale’s has an international presence with locations in Dubai and Kuwait. Founded in 1872, the iconic retailer celebrated its 150th anniversary in 2022. Be sure to follow @bloomingdales on social media, become a Loyallist, and for more information, or to shop any time, visit www.bloomingdales.com.

A beloved Bloomingdale’s destination since its debut in 1974, Forty Carrots is best known for its iconic frozen yogurt, alongside a menu of smoothies, salads, sandwiches and more. It has become a signature part of the shopping experience and a longtime favorite among customers.

About Andy Baraghani

Andy Baraghani is a New York Times bestselling and James Beard Award-winning chef, author, media personality and cultural tastemaker. Born in the Bay Area and now deeply enmeshed in the fabric of New York, Andy has become one of the most sought after names in the food world. At the age of 16, he began working at the world renowned restaurant, Chez Panisse. Andy continued his culinary training at the prestigious L’Arpege in Paris and Estela in New York. He is opening his first restaurant called Ditto, in New York City in fall 2026.
